title: G — instrument weightage differs per outcome, levels averaged after banding
description: The same three instruments count differently towards different outcomes — CO1 is 50/0/50 while CO2 is 30/30/40 — and each instrument is banded on its own before the levels are weight-averaged. An assignment weighted zero for CO1 scores full marks there and must leave CO1 untouched; that is the case that separates this from a single per-assessment weight.
